mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO question_tags (question_id, tag_id) VALUES (#{questionId}, #{tagId})
mapper.select: SELECT t.name FROM question_tags qt JOIN tags t ON qt.tag_id = t.tag_id WHERE qt.question_id = #{questionId} ORDER BY t.name
SELECT qt.question_id AS owner_id, t.name FROM question_tags qt JOIN tags t ON qt.tag_id = t.tag_id WHERE qt.question_id IN #{id} ORDER BY t.name
